description: Canonical fresh-save campaign spine for the current beach vertical slice. Milestones are design targets, not forced timers.

milestones.headline: Fish first; discover cards through play.
milestones.player_goal: Land an eligible coastal catch and recover the Saltworn Card Case.

milestones.headline: Learn the fishing and card loops without pressure.
milestones.player_goal: Catch several species, try early card duels, and begin coastal salvage.

milestones.headline: Fishing starts feeding every other system.
milestones.player_goal: Use fish and gathered materials for bait, gear, cards, and early world rewards.

milestones.headline: Choose what kind of fisherman and card player you are becoming.
milestones.player_goal: Build a stronger tackle set, exploit prepared bait, and push deeper fishing and card progression.

playtest_questions: Does the first fishing trip feel rewarding before cards appear?
Does discovering the Saltworn Card Case feel like a natural surprise rather than a menu unlock?
By hour one, are fishing, selling, gathering and card play all understandable without a tutorial dump?
By hour four, do prepared bait and the Card Maker create meaningful competition for fish and Zenny?
By hour twelve, do players have multiple viable goals instead of one mandatory progression route?
